title: player.json
description: One lecture's slides for a player that shows each slide while its part of the lecture audio plays. Written by slides.assemble: slides.json (slides.schema.json) plus the lecture audio and each slide's narration and audio times. Paths are relative to the player.json file.

audio.description: The lecture MP3, relative to player.json.

narration.description: What the lecture says while this slide shows: the transcript's "## [N]" section.

start_ms.description: Where the slide's narration starts in the audio, in milliseconds: its audio chapter's start.

end_ms.description: Where the slide's narration ends in the audio, in milliseconds: its audio chapter's end.
